title: Joint cohomology comparison for a fixed minimal source complex
statement: Let f:X→S and fi:Xi→S (i in Fin n) be flat proper locally finitely presented, and ui:Xi→X over S, with their structure adjunction units universally isomorphisms. Let L be invertible, k:W→S an immersion, w in W, s=k(w), and assume the source bundle on X_s descends from a finite locally free module on Spec kappa(s). Fix derived localization instances for all schemes and localized open sites. Supply an affine U containing w and trivializations of every Li on Xi×S U. Put E=R(f_W)_*(L_W[0]); supply a strictly perfect connective complex K on the localized module site over U, term isomorphisms K^j≅O_U^{derivedFiberBetti(W,E,j,w)} for every integer j, a derived comparison E|U≅Q(K), and arbitrary linear section bases e0:Gamma(K^0)≅A and e1:Gamma(K^1)≅A^m. Then there exist q≥0 and an A-linear b:A^m→A^q annihilating e1(d_K^0(e0 inverse(a))) for every a in A. For p=ker(A→kappa(w)), there exist an additive equivalence alpha:kappa(p) tensor_A A^m≅H^1(X_s,O) and an additive beta:kappa(p) tensor_A A^q→product_i H^1(Xi_s,O), making beta composed with residue base change of b equal to the family of canonical structure-sheaf cohomology pullbacks composed with alpha. This theorem chooses neither U nor K nor the source bases.

proof.text: Use the supplied target trivializations and perfect direct-image base change to obtain perfect target complexes on the entire affine U. Use the affine bounded-projective characterization and the affine localized-site derived transport to choose bounded finite projective representatives on U. Cancel the negative terms from the lowest degree upward using universal fibre connectiveness: over each local ring the outgoing map of finite free terms is split injective by IsLocalRing.split_injective_iff_lTensor_residueField_injective (Mathlib/RingTheory/LocalRing/Module.lean), so its finitely presented cokernel is locally free and hence finite projective on the affine; split globally and cancel the pair. Use exists_flat_derived_structure_unit for the derived unit and its canonical H-zero fibre comparison, and represent it by a chain map. Its degree-zero cycle is unimodular at every residue field by the universal structure adjunction unit. Split off its structure-module summand. The remaining degree-zero differential is injective on all residue fields, hence has finite locally free cokernel and splits; cancel this contractible pair. The resulting connective strictly perfect target complex has zero outgoing degree-zero differential.

proof.text: Represent the canonical derived coefficient pullback arrows by chain maps from the supplied K to the target complexes. Embed each finite projective degree-one target term as a retract of a finite free module. Identify the finite product of these ambient free modules with A^q. Composing the degree-one components with these embeddings defines b. The chain equations and zero target outgoing degree-zero differentials say that b annihilates every outgoing source degree-zero image.

proof.text: Minimality of the supplied source model identifies its residue degree-one term with its H-one. Trivialize the source fibre using the field rank-one theorem and source descent. On each target project from its ambient free term onto its projective term, then choose a residue-field linear retraction onto the kernel of the outgoing differential. This kernel is target H-one because there are no incoming boundaries. The source chain-map image already lies in this kernel, so the retraction does not change it. Normalize the target trivialization by the scalar comparing it with the pulled-back source trivialization. Affine higher-direct-image/cohomology comparison and naturality of canonical derived base change identify the resulting maps with the canonical structure-sheaf pullbacks. Identify kappa(p), kappa(w), and kappa(s) using affine evaluation and the immersion. The finite product gives beta. For n=0 use q=0; for m=0 the source H-one is zero.
